bottleneck.description: Global #1 in robot vacuum unit share (~19-23%) but operating in a structurally contested consumer-appliance category with at least five well-funded peers; not a critical-input bottleneck for any downstream stack.

dependency.key_customers: Direct-to-consumer (Amazon, Tmall, JD.com, retail), Xiaomi (legacy OEM relationship)
dependency.key_suppliers: Chinese consumer-electronics supply chain (lidar modules, brushless motors, lithium cells, Qualcomm/MTK/Allwinner SoCs)

editorial.notes: Roborock has won meaningful share gains against iRobot, but the robot vacuum market is fragmented with Ecovacs, Dreame, Xiaomi, Narwal, and Dyson all shipping competitive product with rapid SKU refresh cycles. The company is a branded consumer-goods finisher sourcing batteries, motors, lidar modules, and SoCs from commodity suppliers — none of its output is a sole-source input for another industry. Consumer end-markets see ~12 month design cycles and aggressive price competition, the antithesis of switching-cost moats. Clearly LOW.
